title: On Transportation of Mini-batches: A Hierarchical Approach
tldr_zh: BoMb-OT 在 minibatch 之间再解一层 k×k OT 加权聚合，逼近一个真度量；m-OT 是其熵正则 λ→∞ 极限。
tldr_en: Batch-of-Mini-batches OT couples mini-batches with a second-level k x k OT, approximating a true metric; m-OT is its infinite-entropy limit.
key_numbers: CIFAR10 FID 53.44 (BoMb-OT, SW2, k=8, m=50) vs 59.68 (m-OT) (Table 1)
Office-Home avg 70.40 (BoMb-UOT) vs 70.17 (m-UOT/JUMBOT), best in 7/12 tasks (Table 4)
Approximation rate O_P(m^(1-1/p)/n^(1/N)) for W_p, O_P(m^(1-1/p)/n^(1/2)) for SW_p (Theorem 3.4)
Complexity O(k^2(m^2+1)/eps^2) vs m-OT O(k^2 m^2/eps^2) (Sec. 3.1)
